description: Dashboard style gallery: complete, themeable reference dashboards an agent can pick from by style family, use case or mode. Each entry lives in site/dashboards/<id>/ (index.html + style.css + app.js + thumb.jpg + shot.jpg 1440×900 + optional reference.* original). Edit here, then run node scripts/build.mjs and node scripts/dashboards-check.mjs.

style_families.name: Cinematic & atmospheric
style_families.blurb: Dark, moody, scenic backdrops (painted or photographic) with glass panels and one warm accent. For consumer products that should feel like an experience.

style_families.name: Glass & glow
style_families.blurb: Frosted translucent panels over gradients or blurred color fields, soft glows. Modern, techy, premium.

style_families.name: Minimal & airy
style_families.blurb: Lots of white space, hairlines, one accent, quiet type. Calm tools people use all day.

style_families.name: Bento grid
style_families.blurb: Tiles of different sizes in a tight grid, each tile one idea. Great for overviews and product showcases.

style_families.name: Data-dense pro
style_families.blurb: Compact tables, many small charts, tight spacing, monospace numbers. Trading, ops, analytics power users.

style_families.name: Soft & friendly
style_families.blurb: Rounded shapes, pastel fills, playful illustration-free warmth. Health, education, personal apps.

style_families.name: Editorial
style_families.blurb: Big serif headlines, magazine layout, image-led storytelling. Brands, content, luxury.

style_families.name: Bold & graphic
style_families.blurb: High contrast, saturated blocks, heavy type, brutalist or neo-brutalist edges. Creative tools, youth brands.

style_families.name: Dark neon
style_families.blurb: Near-black canvas with vivid neon accents and gradients. Gaming, crypto, music, nightlife.

style_families.name: Tactile & neumorphic
style_families.blurb: Soft extruded surfaces, depth, physical-feeling controls. Smart home, devices, audio.

dashboards.name: Horizon Weather
dashboards.summary: A cinematic weather home: painted sunset landscape behind glass panels, an editorial serif headline, a 7-day forecast strip with a glowing selected day, a smooth gold temperature curve and a mood card.
best_for: Consumer apps where the feeling matters as much as the numbers
Travel, outdoor, hospitality or lifestyle dashboards
Landing-page heroes for a data product
avoid_when: Dense business data (tables, many KPIs): the scenery competes with numbers
Light-mode-only brands
Low-end devices that struggle with backdrop blur

layout.structure: Fixed left sidebar (brand, 5-item nav, quote) · top bar (pill search, bell, avatar) · hero (headline left, current conditions right) over a painted scene · 7-day strip · 3 columns: area chart, details list, story card · popular-locations row
layout.responsive: ≤1180px: chart spans full width above details + story · ≤960px: sidebar becomes a top bar, hero stacks · ≤640px: single column, icon-only nav, day strip scrolls horizontally

components: Area chart with range toggle and hover/focus values
Image story card with serif quote
dashboards.signature: Code-drawn sunset landscape (SVG, themed by CSS variables) fading into the dark UI, with a gold glow ring on the selected day.

source.note: Recreated in original code from a user-supplied concept screenshot. Brand name, photos and copy were replaced; the landscape is drawn in SVG. Owner original stored as `reference.jpg` for 1:1 comparison in the gallery.

dashboards.name: Pulsar Analytics
dashboards.summary: A dark neon product-analytics board: glossy metric orbs switch a topographic mint/violet terrain chart with network nodes, a ticked uptime dial, gradient pillars, and Traffic / Events / Regions pages.
best_for: Product, web or infrastructure analytics for a technical audience
Wall displays and status pages that are read at a glance
Brands that already live in dark mode
avoid_when: Long tables or text-heavy admin screens: the glow tires the eye
Conservative or regulated brands (banking, legal, healthcare)
Print or export-first reporting

components: Metric orbs (toggle buttons that switch the chart)
Topographic multi-layer terrain chart with network overlay
dashboards.signature: Layered mint and violet topographic terrain waves under a neon network of nodes, rising from a blurred purple floor glow.

source.note: Recreated in original code from a user-supplied concept render of a dark analytics board. The render had no readable text, so brand, labels, metrics and all data are invented. Charts, dial, terrain network and orbs are drawn in SVG and CSS. Owner original stored as `reference.jpg` for 1:1 comparison in the gallery.

dashboards.name: Solstice Energy
dashboards.summary: A cinematic solar-monitoring board: a thick gradient sun-path arc rises over a code-drawn mountain range, with generation and load curves on a teal grid, a readout strip, storage dials and round site thumbnails.
best_for: Energy, solar, climate or outdoor-equipment monitoring
A single hero metric that follows the time of day
Control-room or kiosk screens with a strong visual identity
avoid_when: Many records to scan or edit: the hero scene takes most of the first screen
Brands that need a neutral, corporate look
Data with no natural day cycle or location

components: Sun-path arc scene with movable sun
Two-series hourly line chart (pick an hour)
dashboards.signature: A thick yellow-to-orange-to-pink arc tracing the sun's path, cut by faceted orange mountains drawn in SVG; the sun dot moves to the hour you pick.

source.note: Recreated in original code from a user-supplied concept render with no readable text. The domain (solar monitoring), brand, labels and all data are invented. The mountain photo-style art and the round thumbnails were replaced with SVG and CSS landscapes themed by variables. Owner original stored as `reference.jpg` for 1:1 comparison in the gallery.

dashboards.name: Kumo Payroll
dashboards.summary: A moonlit payroll overview: a code-drawn ink landscape with a gold moon, layered hills and a blossom branch sits behind one dark, gold-edged panel holding KPI tiles, a gross/net bar chart, a deductions donut and time-off ring.
best_for: HR, payroll or people tools that want a calm, premium feeling
Hospitality, wellness or boutique brands with an illustrated identity
Monthly summaries with a handful of headline figures
avoid_when: Dense employee tables or bulk editing: the single framed panel limits width
Brands that need a neutral enterprise look
Screens that must fill a wide monitor edge to edge

layout.responsive: ≤1080px: sidebar becomes a scrolling top nav, KPIs 2×2, cards stack · ≤640px: panel offset 130px, icon-only nav, period stepper full width, donut and legend stack

Tinted KPI tiles with change vs. last month
dashboards.signature: A glowing gold moon, ink-line hills and a cherry-blossom branch drawn in SVG behind a dark panel with a thin gold edge.

The painted moon, hills and blossoms are redrawn as SVG themed by CSS variables; the pagoda, koi and lotus artwork were left out. Owner original stored as `reference.jpg` for 1:1 comparison in the gallery.

dashboards.name: Canopy Reforest
dashboards.summary: An organic reforestation tracker in forest green, bark brown and tan: a leafy photo hero with a rounded headline, a deep green band of four site figures and six soft, colour-blocked tiles for species, planting, soil, forest scene, tasks and crews — plus Tasks, Sites and Settings pages.
best_for: Sustainability, conservation, farming or garden projects
Public-facing progress pages that mix a landing-page hero with live figures
Community or volunteer tools that should feel welcoming
avoid_when: Dense operational data or long tables
Finance, security or other serious, high-precision domains
Products that need many chart colours: the palette is deliberately narrow

layout.structure: Centred 1240px column · top bar · diagonal hero (copy left, leaf photo right) · 4-column metrics band · 3×2 colour tiles including forest photo

dashboards.name: Ridgeline Trails
dashboards.summary: A two-tone visitor report for a trail network: a pale, quiet upper half where a misty code-drawn mountain range fades in from the right, then a wave edge into a charcoal lower half of raised pie dials, thin bars and a gold ring gauge.
best_for: Parks, outdoor, travel or architecture brands that want restraint
Weekly or seasonal reports shown on a tablet or wall display
A small number of figures that should feel like a printed page
avoid_when: Many KPIs or tables: the artwork takes the right half of the first screen
Products that need a colourful, energetic brand
Dense operational tools where every pixel carries data

layout.structure: One framed board, max 1280px, thick dark bezel · upper half (pale): centred title + period toggle, left column of 2 ring stats, 2 big numbers and a line chart, right column mountain art with a conditions card · wave-shaped edge · lower half (charcoal): 4 columns (thin bar list, 2 pie dials with legends, ring gauge + small table)

Raised pie dial with tick ring and selectable legend
dashboards.signature: Grey mountain ridges separated by bands of mist, with an ochre forest on the front slope, dissolving into the page and cut off by a wave edge into the charcoal half.

source.note: Recreated in original code from a user-supplied concept render with unreadable text. The domain (trail-network visitor report), name, labels and data are invented; the render's title wordmark was not reused. The mountain photograph was replaced with layered SVG ridges, mist gradients and triangle trees themed by CSS variables. Owner original stored as `reference.jpg` for 1:1 comparison in the gallery.

dashboards.name: Haven Listings
dashboards.summary: A property browser built around one large dusk scene: a code-drawn curved house glows under a blue sky, white filter tabs notch into the top edge, and a frosted card shows the selected home. Listings, price history and viewings sit below.
best_for: Real-estate, hospitality or travel products that sell one hero item at a time
Browse-and-shortlist flows with a few filters
Brands that want a showroom feeling rather than a data tool
avoid_when: Agents managing hundreds of listings: there is no table or map
Dense analytics: only one chart fits naturally
Low-end devices where backdrop blur is costly (the card falls back to a near-opaque fill)

layout.structure: 600px rounded stage with a full-bleed scene: top row (Buy pill, notched filter tab with 3 selects, Rent pill) · left 60px pill rail of 6 icons · headline and lede · white match-count card bottom-left · frosted detail card bottom-right (340px) · below: 3 cards (matching homes list, price-history line chart, viewings with a book button)

Selectable listing rows with drawn thumbnails

source.note: Recreated in original code from a user-supplied design shot of a real-estate landing screen. The studio and product names, logo mark, headline, listing text and avatar were not reused; all homes, addresses and prices are invented. The rendered villa photo was replaced with an SVG house and sky themed by CSS variables. Owner original stored as `reference.jpg` for 1:1 comparison in the gallery.

dashboards.name: Aura Ring
dashboards.summary: A wellness overview for a smart ring: frosted, softly bordered cards float over a periwinkle-to-pink haze, with a two-weight headline, a score dial, thin white line charts, a code-drawn metal ring and a tappable body map.
best_for: Wearables, sleep, wellness and other consumer health products
Tablet-first overviews with a few scores and one device
Brands that want a calm, ambient feeling
avoid_when: Clinical tools where precision and density matter more than mood
Long tables or many KPIs
Interfaces that must work without colour gradients (print, e-ink)

White pill buttons with round arrow

source.note: Recreated in original code from a user-supplied product shot of a wellness tablet app. The product and agency names, logo, avatar photo and copy were not reused; scores and text are invented. The ring photo, 3D body figure and brain render were replaced with an SVG ring, a simple SVG figure with selectable points and a CSS orb. Owner original stored as `reference.jpg` for 1:1 comparison in the gallery.

dashboards.name: Lull Sleep
dashboards.summary: A soft glass wellness board over a lavender sky: score and smart ring at the center, stress and sleep sparks, heart rate, and a glowing body report — with Sleep, Recovery, Activity and Settings pages.
best_for: Sleep, wearables and wellness apps with a nightly report
Detail screens that explain one record with a few linked views
Consumer products where tone matters as much as numbers
avoid_when: Clinical sleep studies that need full hypnogram precision
Multi-user or admin views
Brands that need a crisp, technical feel

dashboards.name: Pearlwell Dental
dashboards.summary: A soft mint patient portal for a dental clinic: one saturated next-visit card with a code-drawn tooth and shield, a health-score ring, a booking calendar with times and dentists, a searchable treatment price list and a tappable tooth chart.
best_for: Clinics, dentists, physio and other appointment-led health services
Patient or client portals that centre on booking
Brands that want a calm, clinical-but-friendly feel
avoid_when: Clinic staff tools with schedules for many patients
Dense reporting or finance views
Brands that need a dark or dramatic look

layout.structure: 230px sticky sidebar (brand, 5 nav links, emergency note) · main: greeting header with search and avatar · 12-column grid: next visit (5) + score (3) + treatments (4, two rows) · booking card (8, two rows: month calendar left, times, dentists and confirm right) · tooth chart (4)

dashboards.name: Vitalis Care
dashboards.summary: A bento-grid patient dashboard for a family clinic: clay doctor hero photo, dimensional heart, floating medical props, tinted vital tiles, teal next-appointment card, doctor directory with booking, activity chart, quick actions, and Vitals / Appointments / Records / Settings pages.
best_for: Clinics, telehealth and family-health apps
Portals that join a directory to booking
Overviews that mix live readings with tasks
avoid_when: Hospital staff tools with many patients
Pages that need one dominant chart
Brands that want a dark or dramatic look

layout.responsive: ≤1100px: 4-column bento (vitals pair, directory + booking side by side) · ≤700px: 2-column bento with vitals side by side, everything else full width, nav on its own row

dashboards.signature: A clay doctor hero beside the greeting, floating medical props at the stage edges, and a glossy dimensional heart with a coral pulse trace in a tight bento of tinted tiles.

source.note: Recreated in original code from a user-supplied concept sheet of six medical phone screens (same set as Pearlwell Dental, different clinic). The screens were merged into a bento desktop layout that differs from Pearlwell's sidebar portal. Names, photos and copy were not reused; doctors, readings and records are invented and phone links use 555 numbers. Doctor and heart imagery are original GenerateImage clay assets in `media/`; floating medical props are code-drawn SVG. Fidelity pass used local tesseract OCR on `reference.jpg` plus visual compare to `shot.jpg`. Owner original stored as `reference.jpg` for 1:1 comparison in the gallery.

dashboards.name: Mallow Music
dashboards.summary: A claymorphic listening dashboard for a music app: puffy pastel tiles with soft inner highlights, a peach hero with code-drawn clay headphones and a plant, a now-playing bar you can scrub, colourful weekly listening bars, a genre donut, recently played songs and a daily mix drawn as a cosy room.
best_for: Music, podcast and audiobook apps with a personal home screen
Consumer products aimed at a young or casual audience
Dashboards where personality matters more than density
avoid_when: Professional or financial tools
Dense data that needs flat, sharp charts
Brands that want a serious or premium feel

source.note: Recreated in original code from a user-supplied claymorphism music-app render. Layout and mood were kept; the cartoon girl, photos, artist names and copy were not reused. Artists and songs are invented. Characters and photos were replaced with SVG headphones, a plant, a crown, generated cover art and a room scene. Owner original stored as `reference.jpg` for 1:1 comparison in the gallery.

dashboards.name: Taffy Analytics
dashboards.summary: A calm pastel product-analytics dashboard for a design-tool startup: a serif headline number over a soft area chart, a row of glossy 3D capsules for sign-ups by channel, a rounded plan-mix ring, springy feature-flag switches and a release checklist.
best_for: Product and growth overviews for small SaaS teams
Internal admin pages with flags and checklists
Brands that want soft, tactile charts instead of hard lines
avoid_when: Dense reporting with many series
Finance or ops tools that need exact gridlines
Dark, technical brands

source.note: Recreated in original code from a user-supplied render of a pastel 3D UI kit with no real content (placeholder text). The capsule bars, round icon buttons, elastic switches and wave card were turned into a working analytics page with invented data. No artwork was copied; all shapes are CSS and SVG. Owner original stored as `reference.jpg` for 1:1 comparison in the gallery.

dashboards.name: Prism Workspace
dashboards.summary: Workspace settings in a light liquid-glass style: thick translucent pills with bright rims over soft pastel blobs. Invite people through a keyboard-friendly suggestion list, filter and remove members, tick permissions, flip notification switches and watch seats fill a folder-shaped plan card.
best_for: Settings and admin pages for team or collaboration tools
Products that want an Apple-like glass look without hurting readability
Onboarding steps such as inviting a team
avoid_when: Data-dense screens or tables
Low-end devices where backdrop blur is costly
Brands that want flat or high-contrast UI

Its pill buttons, round icon buttons, suggestion list, switches, checkboxes, speech bubble and folder card became a working workspace-settings page with invented people and data. All shapes are CSS. Owner original stored as `reference.jpg` for 1:1 comparison in the gallery.

dashboards.name: Plumage Bird Survey
dashboards.summary: A dark, cinematic monitoring dashboard for a volunteer coastal bird survey. A code-drawn, rainbow-feathered bird sits between walls of teal and amber leaves, framed by gradient region charts, coverage and nesting rings, habitat donuts, ranked species bars and an observation log you can filter by species.
best_for: Ecology, conservation and citizen-science reporting
Public-facing impact dashboards that need a memorable hero
Seasonal monitoring with a few headline numbers
avoid_when: Dense operational tools used all day
Calm or corporate brands
Screens where the art would push data below the fold on small laptops

dashboards.name: Hollow Vault
dashboards.summary: A dark-neon rewards hub for a fantasy game. Eight code-drawn relics ring a glowing chest; open it with keys earned from quests and see what you win. Drop rates are shown openly, your haul fills in below, and guild chat runs down the right.

Reward, loyalty or achievement pages
Products that want a show-piece centre element
avoid_when: Anything involving real-money loot boxes or gambling
Business tools and serious reporting
Light, minimal brands

Seasonal brands that want a scenic hero

Bright, high-energy brands
Screens that must show many rooms at once

In-home tablets and wall panels with a living-room hero
Energy glance views paired with climate and lighting
